description_excerpt: KEY PURPOSE OF THE JOB This role sits within VF’s Quality organization and reports to the Senior Manager, Material Quality. This role partners with Tier 2 material suppliers/tanneries, Tier 1 Footwear factories, Material Sourcing, Product Development, Manufacturing Engineering and Product Stewardship teams. This role supports quality assurance and risk mitigation for leather and related materials.
